metadata.description: AI Demo Marketplace — a Claude Code plugin catalog for the AI Agentic Engineering workshop (skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers).

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only research agent that gathers and fact-checks information from the codebase or the public web.

plugins.name: frontend-skills
plugins.description: Frontend skill pack for React 19 + Next.js 15 (App Router): code architecture/placement, React best practices, and Next.js patterns.

plugins.name: typescript-skills
plugins.description: Language-level TypeScript skill pack: type-level programming, strictness settings, utility types, and a diagnostic script.

plugins.name: testing-skills
plugins.description: Testing skill pack: React Testing Library conventions for component and hook tests with Vitest.

plugins.name: code-agents
plugins.description: Execution agents usable with or without a spec-driven workflow: `implementer` and `test-writer`.

plugins.name: sdd-workflow
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development workflow (spec -> plan -> implement -> test -> verify -> retro) with slash commands. Depends on research-tools, code-agents and frontend-skills.
